items.title: Log-seed explicit PRG for read-once depth-two AC0 with parity via iterated restrictions
items.author: Dean Doron; Pooya Hatami; William M. Hoza
items.source_version: CCC2020 formal36-page CC BY3.0 Unported publication; faithful complete editable transcription of main theorem and Sections2–5
items.difficulty_reason: The non-routine construction combines subset-wise symmetric tail control with three complementary restriction analyses, then uses a recursive proper-formula scheme whose seed costs form a geometric series and whose error remains near-optimal.

primary.label: Formal Theorem1 complete model, explicitness,seed/error statement and Section1.4 model context

proof_spans.label: Formal Section2 complete subset-wise symmetric definitions, deterministic/probabilistic tail lemmas and every local continuation
Formal Section3 complete probability/small-bias/limited-independence/formula/restriction definitions and all author local proofs
Formal Section4.1–4.3 constants/distributions/buckets and complete heavy-bucket bias/moment/Chernoff argument
Formal Section4.4 setup and complete sparse-bucket ROBP/Fourier/Forbes-Kelley argument
Formal Section4.4.2 complete exceptional/good-term decomposition, normalized symmetric expansion,conditional-error and spectral-norm Claims18–24
Formal Sections4.4.3–4.4.4 complete combination and Lemma22/Claim25 moment/tail/spectral proof
Formal Section5 complete proper-formula restrictions,long/base PRGs,recursive error/seed induction,arbitrary-error/width and final model reduction
